neural_layer_responsibilities: Open-vocabulary semantic understanding and zero-shot reasoning
Contextual homophone disambiguation in conversational transcripts
Implicit intent classification and high-context Sasshi resolution
Continuous text generation and translation hypothesis scoring
rule_fst_layer_responsibilities: Strict grammatical Katsuyou verb conjugation (100% deterministic)
Adjective inflection and sound euphony (Onbin) generation
Keigo honorific elevation and anti-pattern blocking (double honorifics)
Numerical classifier agreement (counter constraints per shape)
Orthographic punctuation integrity and Kagikakko balancing
hybrid_policy.arbitration_rule: The deterministic rule/FST layer acts as a hard filter on neural generator outputs. Any neural generation that violates Keigo concord or introduces ungrammatical Katsuyou is rejected or auto-corrected.
